title: Video Editing Services in Dallas
metaTitle: Video Editing Services in Dallas, TX | TDM
metaDescription: Video editing for Dallas businesses: ad cuts, reels, product videos, corporate and event footage, edited at TDM's Lahore hub and delivered in every format.
lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) edits video for Dallas businesses. You send raw footage and we return finished, platform-ready videos: ad cuts, reels, product videos, brand films and social clips. Editing is done by our editors at TDM's production hub in Lahore, not in Dallas, and files, feedback and approvals move online. Many Dallas companies already have plenty of footage from events, offices, job sites and creators. What they lack is someone to turn it into something watchable.

sections.heading: The footage Dallas companies already have
paragraphs: A corporate city records a lot of video and publishes little of it. There are conference talks and panel sessions, webinars, town halls, customer interviews and recruitment clips sitting on shared drives in offices from downtown to Legacy West. A one-hour session can become a short highlights film, a handful of captioned clips for LinkedIn and a cut for the careers page, if somebody does the work.

Other businesses have different raw material. Roofers and builders hold drone clips and before-and-after phone footage. Brands that exhibit at the Dallas Market Center come home with booth walk-throughs and product demonstrations. Restaurants in Deep Ellum or Bishop Arts film their own kitchens every week. Product brands receive clips from creators in every shape and quality. All of it can be edited into advertising and social content without another shoot.

sections.heading: What the editing covers
paragraphs: We handle everything after the camera stops: cutting, pacing, colour, sound, captions, motion graphics and export.
bullets: Paid-social ad cuts with several opening hooks, so the ad account has real variations to test.
Reels and short-form clips in 9:16, feed versions in 1:1 and 4:5, and 16:9 for YouTube and websites.
Burned-in captions, since most feed video is watched without sound.
Corporate and event edits: highlights, speaker clips, interviews and internal communications.
Product and brand videos with titles, graphics and licensed music.
Clean-up of mixed creator and phone footage: stabilising, colour matching and audio repair.

sections.heading: How remote editing works from Dallas
paragraphs: You upload footage to a shared folder with a short brief: what the video is for, where it will run and any brand rules. We send a first cut, you leave comments against the timestamps and we revise. Lahore is many hours ahead of Central Time, so work on a cut often moves forward while Dallas is asleep, and feedback sent at the end of your day can be picked up before your next morning.

Where TDM also manages the advertising, editors see how each cut performs in the account, including how long viewers stay and how many click, and rework the weak ones. Editing then becomes a running process, not a single delivery.

sections.heading: What to agree before sending footage
paragraphs: Settle how many finished videos you expect, in which lengths and aspect ratios, and how many rounds of revision are included. Check who supplies music and whether it is licensed for advertising. If people appear on camera, make sure you hold their consent, especially employees and customers. For regulated fields such as medical and financial services, decide who signs off claims before a video is published. We record these points in the brief.

presence: TDM does not have an office or an edit suite in Dallas. We serve Dallas businesses remotely, and all editing is carried out at our production hub in Lahore. Footage is transferred online and you review cuts through a shared link.

faqs.q: Do you have video editors in Dallas?
faqs.a: No. Our editors work from TDM's production hub in Lahore and serve Dallas clients remotely. You upload footage, review cuts online and give timestamped feedback.

faqs.q: How much does video editing cost for a Dallas business?
faqs.a: Pricing reflects the scope: the amount of footage, the number of finished videos and the level of graphics and versioning. A free consultation comes first, then a quote.

faqs.q: Can you edit footage we filmed on phones?
faqs.a: Yes. Phone footage is often the right look for social content and ads. We stabilise it where needed, correct colour and sound, add captions and cut it to the right length.

faqs.q: How quickly will we get our videos back?
faqs.a: Turnaround depends on the requirements and the brief, including how much footage there is and how many versions are needed. Delivery dates are agreed in the plan before work starts.

faqs.q: Can one long recording become several videos?
faqs.a: Yes. A recorded talk, webinar or interview can usually yield a highlights edit and a set of short clips for different channels. We plan the list of outputs with you before cutting.
